events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey one-pagers and probe args
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/offers/; grep -n '\$' workshop-plan/offers/{pro,scale,enterprise,pro-course}.md | head -30; grep -c '[–—]' workshop-plan/offers/*.md; head -40 app/scripts/probe-tier-qualifier.mjs | grep -n 'BASE\|argv\|env'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check annual price lines against prices.json
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 18,30p workshop-plan/offers/pro.md; sed -n 18,26p workshop-plan/offers/scale.md; find . -name prices.json -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head; grep -rn 'annual\|999\|169\|89' $(find . -name prices.json -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head -2) | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read one-pager heads and qualifier price copy
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,17p workshop-plan/offers/pro.md; sed -n 1,17p workshop-plan/offers/scale.md; git log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -3 -- workshop-plan/offers/pro.md; grep -n 'price\|Line\|\$' app/src/components/masterclass/tier-qualifier.tsx | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm annual prices in owner pricing memory
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/; ls | grep -i pric; grep -rln 'pricing-2026-10-15' . | head -3; grep -rh -i 'annual\|89\|169' $(ls | grep -i 'pricing-2026-10-15') 2>/dev/null | head -8

events.text: Prices match the 2026-10-15 owner decision. Now the live probe and the row cleanup.

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; sed -n 1,30p scripts/probe-tier-qualifier.mjs | grep -n 'path\|logForm\|intercept\|route' | head; BASE=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site timeout 300 node scripts/probe-tier-qualifier.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8
